disposition_reason: Sixteen composite samples of five wild edible mushroom species from southern Spain and northern Morocco analysed by ICP-MS for chromium, arsenic, cadmium, mercury, lead, copper, zinc and selenium; per-sample values in Table 3.

study.design: Field collection of wild fruiting bodies, composite per site
study.origin: Natural forests in Malaga and Cadiz (Spain) and Bouhachem Natural Park, Chaouen (Morocco)
study.method: Block digestion HNO3/HCl then H2O2, ICP-MS (Thermo X Series II) with KED
lod: LODs for Cr, As, Cd, Hg, Pb, Cu, Zn, Se within 0.002-0.1 mg/kg DW; arsenic printed as <0.200 for two samples
study.qa: Triplicates, blanks and CRM CS-M-3 Boletus edulis powder; recoveries within 70-130%
